examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Outlined button trigger. Hover or focus “Hover me” to reveal the tooltip.

examples.name: Placements
examples.summary: All four anchor sides with directional arrow triggers. Hover or focus each icon button to compare sides; `start` and `end` follow the text direction.

examples.name: AutoPlacement
examples.summary: `side="auto"` lets the tooltip pick the side with the most available space at open time. The four edge-positioned triggers all share the same prop value. Hover or focus each one: its tooltip resolves to the side that fits best, reflected in `data-side`.
